title: OffSec Launches Free PHP2Shell Lab Following Critical Vulnerability Discovery
content_md: New York, United States, October 28th, 2026, CyberNewswire New hands-on lab lets security practitioners explore PHP2Shell exploitation firsthand as AI-assisted research reshapes vulnerability discovery.
